text:
ivy: Drafting relnotes + changelog blurb for the Adaptive Routing rollout. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4892 
carlos: quick read. please add a short Dedicated migration checklist and a one-line "what to expect" for perf (customers ask about cache effects)
priya: also update SDK snippets JS and Python method names changed in v1. JS streaming now uses client.text.createStream; Python import is `from redwood import Client`
ivy: thanks. added migration checklist (pin variant -> warm cache -> run quick eval) and a one-liner explaining prefix-cache warmup may add a small latency spike for a few minutes. added JS + Python snippets
ci-bot: snippet-tests: streaming example timed out on first run; retrying
ci-bot: snippet-tests: passed on retry. markdown-lint: wrapped long lines
link-bot: linkcheck: /guides/dedicated/pin -> 404. Suggest /guides/dedicated/variant-pinning. Also external https://thirdparty.example.com/quant-advice -> 410; converted to inline advisory text
carlos: please add a short rollout cadence for SEs/Support: canary 10% 4h, 50% 12h, ramp to 100% after 24h if metrics stable. rollback triggers: error-rate > 0.8% sustained 10m OR p95 latency +30%
priya: small nit in the JS examples: non-stream path uses `await client.generate`  change to `await client.text.generate`. Also add a comment about auth scope for variant pinning (dedicated:variants:write)
ivy: fixed JS example, added auth-scope note, and included a tiny warmup curl snippet: ```bash
# safe warmup example: 5 RPS per GPU, backoff on 429s
for i in {1..30}; do
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/text.generate \
    -d '{"model":"kestrel-13b","input":"warmup"}' || true
  sleep 0.2
done
```
carlos: add a short Known Issues bullet: streaming embeddings token counts can be off by ~1 token on some legacy quantized builds; fallback to quantized variant may produce minor punctuation changes in ~0.5% of cases. advise pinning if quality sensitive
priya: suggest adding a preflight eval snippet and checklist (run canonical prompts, compare top-k tokens, smoke test streaming)
ivy: added preflight eval curl and checklist. also included a concise changelog line: "Adaptive routing: prioritized routing, variant pinning, and graceful fallbacks (see docs for migration notes)"
ci-bot: deploy-preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/4892/relnotes-adaptive-routing
link-bot: preview linkcheck: internal links OK. external advisory text validated
ivy: plan to merge in ~8m and schedule publish 09:00 UTC tomorrow. will ping #announcements and #support with relnote + migration checklist after publish. objections? :thumbsup:
carlos: :thumbsup:
priya: +1
ivy: merged and scheduled. thanks all!
